title.en: Elements of art: line and shape

summary.en: Students explore how lines and shapes form the building blocks of visual art, experimenting with different line qualities and geometric and organic shapes.

summary.en: This unit introduces the colour wheel, primary and secondary colours, and how warm and cool colours create mood in artwork.

summary.en: Students develop drawing skills by observing real objects, practising proportion, shading and still life composition.
